digest.component_or_area: LLM provider inference and model resolution
propositions: infer_provider('gemini-2.5-pro') maps to 'google_genai', which is neither in pydantic-ai's known provider names nor in ProviderSession._builders, causing LLMConfigError at call time

the model-class resolution path (model_classes._resolve_target) composes an unresolvable 'google_genai:gemini-*' string that fails provider construction, while the bare model path (anthropic_model._pai_model) accidentally survives via a private _PAI_PROVIDER_PREFIX translation table
_PROVIDER_PREFIXES must map 'gemini' to 'google', pydantic-ai's canonical Gemini Developer API provider name that is already resolvable in both KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES and pydantic-ai's registries
all values in _PROVIDER_PREFIXES must map to provider names that are either in _pydantic_ai_known_providers() or in ProviderSession._builders to prevent future defects from added prefixes
